bed_file.description: Path to the genomic regions file to do the pileups for.

genome_file.description: Path to the reference genome file.

mirna_file.description: Path to the reference miRNA file.

map_chr_file.description: Path to the chromosome names mapping table.

intermediates_dir.description: Path to the directory storing the intermediate files.

pileups_dir.description: Path to the directory storing the ASCII-style pileups.

local_log.description: Path to the local log directory.

cluster_log.description: Path to the cluster log directory.

extension.description: Number of nucleotides to extend the mature miRNA start and end coordinates.

q_value.description: Q (Phred) score. Minimum quality score to keep.

p_value.description: Minimum % of bases that must have Q quality.

minimum_length.description: Discard processed reads shorter than the indicated length.

overlap.description: Minimum overlap length of adapter and read to trim the bases.

max_n.description: Discard reads containing more than the indicated number of N bases.

max_length_reads.description: Maximum length of processed reads to map with oligomap.

nh.description: Discard read with more mappings than the indicated number.

lib_dict.description: Dictionary of arbitrary condition names (keys) and library names to aggregate alignment pileups for (values; MUST correspond to names in samples table).

sort_by.description: Sort pileups by the first nucleotide's position from left-to-right ('position') or by counts in descending order ('counts').

min_count_dict.description: Dictionary with the minimum count for a sequence to be kept for each pileup group; per run, per library, per condition.

split.description: Split precursor pileups into one mature-arm pileup per arm.

canonical.description: Mark the aligned read corresponding to the canonical mature sequence.

keep_all.description: Write the pileup even if it as no aligned sequences.

keep_info.description: Keep genomic coordinates and feature names on the final display.

max_seq.description: Maximum number of top sequences to display.

color_dict.description: Dictionary with the minimum count for a sequence to be kept for each pileup group; per run, per library, per condition.
